title: For an exact additive left adjoint strong monoidal F, a functor G and counit γ satisfying the tensor/counit square, and braided compatibility of F, the canonical derived tensor route composed with tensorModelTargetWith equals tensorModelMapWith for every homotopy complex and every fixed coefficient B
statement: Let C,D be Grothendieck abelian braided closed monoidal categories with monoidal preadditivity and functorial flat resolutions. Let F:C→D be an exact additive left adjoint strong monoidal functor, G:Derived(C)→Derived(D) an oplax monoidal functor and γ:Qh⋙G→Fh⋙Qh a natural transformation. Assume the tensor/counit square δ_G(QhK,QhL);(γK⊗γL);μ_Qh = G(μ_Qh(K,L));γ(K⊗L);Qh(δ_Fh(K,L)) and braiding compatibility F(β(X,Y));δ_F(Y,X)=δ_F(X,Y);β(FX,FY). For any coefficient B:C, functor H:Derived(C)→Derived(C) left deriving tensorLeft(B) with counit ε, and homotopy complex P, G((derivedTensorPresentationIso B H ε).hom.app(QhP));δ_G(QhP,single(B));tensorModelTargetWith F G γ B P = tensorModelMapWith F G γ B H ε P. No K-flatness of P is needed.

source.place: Lemma 6.5.9(5), Remark 6.8.15; formal tensor and counit normalization

proof.text: Naturality moves the coefficient single comparison through the tensorator. The braiding equation for homotopy pullback moves the coefficient to the first factor. Apply the assumed tensor/counit square. Naturality of γ moves the braiding across its component. Normalize the derived tensor presentation using derivedTensorPresentationIso_fac. Finally apply naturality of γ to the homotopy single-tensor isomorphism. These identities give exactly tensorModelMapWith; no K-flat hypothesis is used.

theorem CategoryTheory.Functor.tensorModelRoute_fac (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    [F.IsLeftAdjoint] [F.Monoidal]
    (G : DerivedCategory C ⥤ DerivedCategory D)
    (γ : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ G ⟶
      F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
    [G.OplaxMonoidal]
    (hδ : ∀ K L : HomotopyCategory C (.up ℤ),
      Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ G (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj K) (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj L) ≫
        (γ.app K ⊗ₘ γ.app L) ≫ Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ DerivedCategory.Qh
          ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj K)
          ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj L) =
        G.map (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ DerivedCategory.Qh K L) ≫ γ.app (K ⊗ L) ≫
          DerivedCategory.Qh.map
            (((Functor.OplaxMonoidal.mapHomotopyCategoryδNatTrans (.up ℤ) F).app K).app L))
    (hG : ∀ X Y : C, F.map (β_ X Y).hom ≫ Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ F Y X =
      Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ F X Y ≫ (β_ (F.obj X) (F.obj Y)).hom)
    (B : C) (H : DerivedCategory C ⥤ DerivedCategory C)
    (ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ H ⟶
      (tensorLeft B).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
    [H.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso C (.up ℤ))]
    (P : HomotopyCategory C (.up ℤ))
 :
    G.map
          ((derivedTensorPresentationIso B H ε).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P)) ≫
        Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ G (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj P)
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor C 0).obj B) ≫
        Functor.tensorModelTargetWith F G γ B P = Functor.tensorModelMapWith F G γ B H ε P
